text: Geology is a fundamental discipline that studies the composition, internal structure, evolutionary history and formation mechanisms of the Earth (including the solid Earth and its layers, as well as celestial bodies and related substances). It is known as the "cornerstone of Earth science". Through observing natural relics such as rocks, fossils, and geological structures, it reveals the evolutionary laws of the Earth over 4.6 billion years. At the same time, it provides scientific basis for resource exploration, environmental protection, and disaster prevention, and serves as a bridge connecting natural sciences and engineering applications.
